timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=15s 2700s /inspire/hdd/project/project-public/<inspire-account>/nancy/conda-envs/grm-exp/bin/python3.10 -u -B /inspire/hdd/global_user/<inspire-account>/nancy/experiment1_stage09/h1_recovery_test_20261029_r1/delivery/evaluate_test.py --root /inspire/hdd/global_user/<inspire-account>/nancy/experiment1_stage09/h1_recovery_20261028_r2 --parent /inspire/hdd/global_user/<inspire-account>/nancy/experiment1_stage09/goal_20261027_r1/runs/H1/best.pt --policy decay --output /inspire/hdd/global_user/<inspire-account>/nancy/experiment1_stage09/h1_recovery_test_20261029_r1/H1-decay > /inspire/hdd/global_user/<inspire-account>/nancy/experiment1_stage09/h1_recovery_test_20261029_r1/logs/decay.log 2>&1'
